---
title: Unknown Components
---

These components aren't implemented. They must degrade to their children rather
than crash the page.

<Mystery>UNKNOWN_CHILD_MARKER</Mystery>

This used to use `<Tree.File>` as the member-expression example — until Tree was actually
implemented, at which point this fixture started asserting the fallback against a real
component and failed. The example has to be a name we genuinely don't ship, so it's a
deliberately invented one:

<Widget.Panel>MEMBER_EXPR_MARKER</Widget.Panel>
